headline: Freigabe erforderlich — Löschbefehl
command:
STAMP=20261030-premigration
ssh -i "$HOME/.ssh/rocketory-mittwald" -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o PreferredAuthentications=publickey -o ConnectTimeout=15 -l "nicolas@viralista.de@a-fghqd3" ssh.lashorst.project.host "cat ~/backups/$STAMP/rocketory-data.tgz" > "backups/$STAMP/rocketory-data.tgz" && rm -f "backups/$STAMP/rocketory-data.tgz.part" "backups/$STAMP/ssh.err" && chmod 600 "backups/$STAMP/rocketory-data.tgz" && tar -tzf "backups/$STAMP/rocketory-data.tgz" | awk 'NR<=3; END{print NR" Dateien"}' && ls -la "backups/$STAMP"
echo "--- live checks ---"
for u in / /admin /api/form-settings /standorte /blog/human-in-the-loop-qualitaetskontrolle-webdesign /ki-check /kontakt /blog; do echo "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" --max-time 20 "https://rocketory.de$u") $u"; done
echo "www: $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}" --max-time 10 https://www.rocketory.de/)"
